emergence.summary: A single-gene ATP7B loss-of-function disables the copper-transporting ATPase that exports hepatic copper into bile and loads it onto ceruloplasmin. Without it, copper is not excreted and ACCUMULATES in liver and brain, where free copper is toxic -> the copper burden is driven UP. Read as a released BRAKE on copper accumulation (ATP7B brakes the build-up; LOF releases it -> copper UP). The kit re-derives the approved therapy, which REMOVES or BLOCKS copper rather than restoring the transporter: chelation (penicillamine / trientine) promotes urinary copper excretion, and zinc blocks intestinal copper absorption (maintenance); restoring ATP7B export is investigational gene therapy. The gamma read is of the ATP7B locus switch structure; the disease lesion is coding, outside the promoter firewall. Magnitude [O].
emergence.emergent_axis: free / loosely-bound copper burden (hepatic and CNS copper accumulation)

grades.perturbation_direction: [F] forced by (role x mechanism); cited biology
grades.perturbation_magnitude: [O] OPEN -- how far the switch moves is runtime/Layer-2, not sequence-derivable

per_gene.note: ATP7B is a copper-transporting P-type ATPase that exports hepatic copper to bile and loads ceruloplasmin. As a BRAKE on copper accumulation, its LOF RELEASES the brake -> biliary copper excretion fails and copper accumulates (toxic in liver and brain). The promoter gamma reads the locus switch STRUCTURE only; it does NOT encode the coding lesion (firewall). The pathological axis is the COPPER BURDEN (it goes UP), so the corrective levers LOWER it.
per_gene.src: Bull 1993 Nat Genet 5:327; Tanzi 1993 Nat Genet 5:344

emergence.firewall: gamma reads promoter switch-threshold STRUCTURE only; perturbation DIRECTION is forced+cited; MAGNITUDE is [O] (runtime/Layer-2, not sequence-derivable).

levers.push_direction: chelate copper to promote urinary excretion -> lower the toxic copper burden (bypasses the ATP7B export defect)
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] copper-clearance magnitude / outcome not derived from sequence

levers.push_direction: block intestinal copper ABSORPTION via metallothionein induction -> lower copper input (maintenance)
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] absorption-blockade magnitude not derived from sequence
levers.src: Brewer 1983; zinc acetate FDA-approved for Wilson maintenance

levers.push_direction: restore ATP7B copper export so biliary excretion resumes -> lower the copper burden (definitive)
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] restored-export magnitude not derived from sequence; investigational

falsifiers.claim: ATP7B LOF (released brake) raises the toxic copper burden (axis UP)
falsifiers.falsifier: an ATP7B null allele that LOWERED hepatic / CNS copper would refute the released-brake direction
falsifiers.measurable_by: hepatic / urinary / CNS copper by ATP7B genotype

falsifiers.claim: removing or blocking copper (chelation / zinc) is the CORRECTIVE direction (lowers the burden)
falsifiers.falsifier: if chelation or absorption-blockade RAISED or failed to lower tissue copper, the restrain-copper lever sign is wrong
falsifiers.measurable_by: tissue / urinary copper response to chelation or zinc
